## Body

BLOCK — performance/266 round 1, exact head 890515121f3d8f38cc96947847e7178ce42e1cc9.

P266-001: the requested no-lock hot-path cost is not implemented. crates/daemon/src/http/route_counts.rs:125-134 acquires one shared std::sync::Mutex for EVERY answered matched request, performs BTreeMap lookup and clones an Arc before its outcome fetch_add. The cold path (:132) also allocates the path String, map entry and counter Arc. GET /v1/seats performs an additional seat-shape fetch_add (:136-137); it is not just one atomic increment. MatchedPath and PathCounts Arc cloning/drop add refcount traffic as well.

More importantly, snapshot (:156-166), called for every ping (http/mod.rs:908), holds the SAME global mutex while formatting all eight method/path names per touched path and inserting active entries into the result BTreeMap. Formatting occurs before checking whether a method slot is zero. Request completion can therefore wait behind snapshot allocation/formatting and other requests. The commit/API words 'uncontended map lookup' are not guaranteed and omit the global lock. This is a source-observed cost-contract mismatch, not a claim that a measured slowdown already occurred; the patch is not deployed in the baseline.

Required change: build the finite route-template -> PathCounts mapping once during router construction from the existing endpoint inventory, keep it immutable for requests/snapshots, and record into inline atomic slots without the shared mutable-map mutex/per-route Arc clone or first-request allocation. Keep fixed unmatched/method/query-shape buckets. Snapshot can allocate its public projection, but must not block request accounting behind those allocations. Correct the docs/cost row to distinguish one outcome increment from the extra seats-query increment, method/template lookup and query-byte scan. No new timer or background aggregation is needed.

| Cost surface at this head | Trigger / scaling | Added launches |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Matched request accounting | One global mutex acquisition + O(log P) path lookup per answered request, method scan <=7, outcome atomic; seats GET additionally O(query bytes) scan and second atomic. Scales with request rate, not directly seats. | 0 by source inspection |
| First request to template | Bounded String/map/counter allocation, serialized by same mutex. | 0 |
| Ping snapshot | O(8P+128) visits, eight formatted keys per touched path under shared mutex, result allocations; P bounded by router templates. | 0 |

Positive findings: no launch, log, event or store write is introduced by this counter implementation; no poll/timer is added. Storage is bounded by trusted MatchedPath templates, eight method slots, one unmatched bucket and 128 fixed seat-shape atomics. Query values/unknown parameters do not create keys. Standard-method warmed record lookup itself does not allocate after that template is inserted, but that is weaker than a no-lock/allocation hot path. spawn_sites.rs is unchanged: exact-head parent diff returned exit 0/no output. The outermost placement includes bearer refusals/job-token routes/fallback; correctness/security verdicts are independently owned.

Baseline carried forward, not rerun or attributed to this patch: note1196f630 on PID74846 e4b63eb1b2, 08:40:35–08:44:35Z, +84.49CPU-s/240.009wall-s=35.20% of one core; previous PID17600 was31.86%.
